status: REVIEW DECISIONS Q1-Q7 SETTLED 2026-09-25 (binding once this protocol is committed); see research/research_protocol_v2.md
relationship_to_v1: V1 (config/research_protocol_v1.json) is not modified and remains the protocol under which MA_BASELINE_V1 and H001-H004 were run and judged. V2 applies to H005 and later only. Splits, universe, execution defaults and the D1-D6 / V1-V4 gates are inherited unchanged; V2 adds a staged pre-portfolio admission process in front of the full portfolio backtest.

universe.symbol_order_note: Order is the live loop order and the same-timestamp tie-break in the backtester (inherited from V1).

data_source.adjustment: raw (unless a hypothesis preregisters otherwise with a reason)
data_source.feed_mixing: never mix IEX and SIP bars inside one strategy run; separate caches; separate manifests/checksums
data_source.historical_note: H001-H004 are historical experiments on IEX and are not rewritten.

feed_policy.mismatch: allowed only if preregistered and justified, naming the operationally authoritative feed; P5 is then mandatory
feed_policy.threshold_sensitive_rules: P5 also applies when research and live feeds match, whenever a secondary feed is available
feed_policy.sip_role: preferred high-quality comparison feed when legally available; primary only when the hypothesis intends SIP as its operational signal feed
feed_policy.sip_access_evidence: historical SIP access confirmed on the existing account by the V1 sanity audit (KNOWN period); nothing purchased or bypassed

splits.name: warmup
splits.purpose: Indicator warm-up and data support only. No results are reported for this window.

splits.name: development
splits.purpose: Hypothesis-generation territory (already conceptually contaminated by H001-H004 and the V1 diagnostics). Pre-portfolio screens and, if admitted, the full Development portfolio run.

splits.name: validation
splits.purpose: First untouched strategy-level evaluation. Opened once, only after spec freeze, P1-P6 PASS, D1-D6 PASS, frozen implementation and recorded implementation commit.

splits.name: known_diagnostic
splits.purpose: Permanently contaminated. Allowed for feed-robustness (Stage 4) and diagnostics; never validation.

splits.name: forward
splits.purpose: Chronological paper observations only, after pre-portfolio, Development and Validation PASS. Never used for design.

execution_defaults.canonical_cost_policy: 5 bps per side is canonical. It is never reduced because a strategy fails; changes require independent real-fill calibration evidence (section 17 of the V2 document).

stage0_spec_freeze.rule: The spec is committed and its hash recorded before any hypothesis signal is calculated.

raw_signal_screen.portfolio_constraints: none (no positions, leverage, halts, capital, symbol blocking)
raw_signal_screen.entry: next executable bar per the frozen spec
raw_signal_screen.weak_forward_excursion_default: MFE at the primary horizon < +0.25R (a hypothesis may preregister another definition)

random_control.default_atr_quintile: rank of ATR14%/close against the previous 1560 bars of the same symbol and timeframe-equivalent history, computed without future information (V1 audit convention, adapted to the hypothesis timeframe in its spec)
random_control.default_seed_rule: numpy default_rng(BASE_SEED + 1000*r + j), BASE_SEED preregistered per hypothesis
random_control.default_exclusions: all raw signal bars of the hypothesis are excluded from candidate pools
random_control.overmatching_rule: do not match on variables derived from the strategy rule itself when that would erase the tested signal
random_control.freeze: matching dimensions, buckets, fallback, replicate count, seeds, replacement and exclusions are frozen in the spec before outcomes

P1_sample_size.counts: VALID raw-signal forward observations (not merely emitted signals)
P1_sample_size.override: a lower minimum only if preregistered with a structural-rarity reason before outcomes; never lowered afterwards

P2_primary_metric_vs_random.primary_metric: exactly one, named in the spec
P2_primary_metric_vs_random.threshold: real value at or above the 95th empirical percentile of the matched-random replicate distribution (for a lower-is-better metric: at or below the 5th)
P2_primary_metric_vs_random.percentile_definition: empirical percentile = (count(random < real) + 0.5 * count(random == real)) / n * 100, over the non-null replicate values (n = their count); exact float comparison, no interpolation; for a lower-is-better metric the oriented percentile is 100 - that value; a missing real value or zero replicates gives no percentile (the gate is then FAIL)
P2_primary_metric_vs_random.percentile_method: empirical percentile = (count(random < real) + 0.5 * count(random == real)) / n * 100, over the non-null replicate values (n = their count); exact float comparison, no interpolation; for a lower-is-better metric the oriented percentile is 100 - that value; a missing real value or zero replicates gives no percentile (the gate is then FAIL)

P3_supporting_metrics.expected_direction_definition: direction-aware: the real value is strictly better than the matched-random replicate median in that metric's preregistered favorable direction

P4_economic_scale.successful_signal: direction_normalized_forward_return_at_primary_horizon > 0 at 0 bps (long: price-direction return; short: its negation)
P4_economic_scale.favorable_move: direction-normalized MFE % at the preregistered primary horizon, median over successful signals
P4_economic_scale.A: roundtrip canonical friction % >= 0.25 x that median favorable move % (no measurable favorable move counts as A)
P4_economic_scale.B: recompute BOTH the real signals and the exact frozen matched-random controls at canonical cost; B holds when the real PRIMARY metric no longer satisfies the same P2 oriented-percentile requirement (>= 95) in its preregistered direction
P4_economic_scale.descriptive_only: if the primary metric is a signed return/expectancy, also report whether it is <= 0 at canonical cost (does not replace B)
P4_economic_scale.matching_design: identical between 0 bps and canonical cost
P4_economic_scale.stricter_criteria: allowed if preregistered; never loosened after outcomes

P5_feed_robustness.applies_to: mandatory when PRIMARY_RESEARCH_FEED != INTENDED_LIVE_SIGNAL_FEED; also for threshold-sensitive rules (exact OHLC thresholds, crossovers, breakouts, close location, other price-sensitive boundaries) whenever a secondary feed is available
P5_feed_robustness.rule: Jaccard < 0.75 fails unless the spec preregistered (1) why sensitivity is expected, (2) which feed is authoritative for research and live operation, (3) why the signal remains operationally meaningful
P5_feed_robustness.not_applicable: only when derived from the frozen declarations (feeds match AND (rule not threshold-sensitive OR no secondary feed)); never used to leave an applicable gate unmeasured
P5_feed_robustness.mismatch_rule: a research/live feed mismatch without a preregistered justification and operationally authoritative feed FAILS P5

pre_portfolio_gates.failure_rule: any mandatory P gate FAIL -> no full portfolio backtest; the hypothesis is closed under its ID
pre_portfolio_gates.outcomes: each of P1-P6 is recorded PASS / FAIL / NOT_APPLICABLE (NOT_APPLICABLE only for P5 as defined); any mandatory gate not measured is FAIL

status_rule.raw_signal_screen_only: any combination of failures limited to P1/P2/P3 -> REJECTED_AT_RAW_SIGNAL_SCREEN
status_rule.multiple_stages: failures spanning more than one distinct stage -> REJECTED_PRE_PORTFOLIO
status_rule.p6: any P6 failure, alone or combined -> REJECTED_PRE_PORTFOLIO

execution_sensitivity_precheck.role: mandatory to run and report at the preregistered costs; NON-GATING evidence (P4 remains the economic admission gate)

development_gates.D6: P_s = realized P&L per tradable symbol; pool = sum max(P_s,0); PASS iff pool > 0 and max share <= 0.50 (exact); pool == 0 FAILS

validation_gates.rule: run once; no tuning after viewing; failure closes the hypothesis

contamination_notes: Development (2024-01-02 -> 2025-12-31) has been explored by MA_BASELINE_V1, H001-H004, several autopsies and Research Sanity Audit V1; every new hypothesis must disclose which Development findings motivated it and which thresholds came from them.
known_diagnostic (2026-06-01 -> 2026-09-23) remains permanently contaminated; it was also used for the IEX-vs-SIP comparison.
Validation (2026-01-02 -> 2026-05-29) has not been viewed by any strategy; broad public macro knowledge of the period exists and is disclosed per hypothesis.
hygiene_rules: Never tune on validation after viewing validation results.
Any meaningful rule change after any stage has been viewed creates a new hypothesis ID; no salvage under the same ID.
The known diagnostic period remains contaminated permanently.
Forward observations are chronological, never back-filled, never used for design.
Do not select symbols because they performed well in validation.
No post-hoc metric switching: the preregistered primary metric controls admission; all metrics are reported.
Report development, validation, contaminated and forward evidence separately; never merge them into one score.
Never mix feeds inside one strategy run.
Canonical cost is never reduced because a strategy fails.

passive_long_baseline.rule: optional diagnostic; if a hypothesis uses one, its entry schedule, symbols, holding/management convention, costs and sample period are preregistered in that hypothesis before outcomes. Matched random remains the mandatory timing baseline.

validation_feed_access: no Validation-period SIP or any other Validation feed is downloaded or read until: spec frozen, P1-P6 all mandatory gates PASS, D1-D6 all PASS, implementation frozen, frozen implementation commit recorded
registry_rule: when H005 is created: tag its entry with research_protocol_v2 and add the V2 statuses to the registry schema/allowed values; H001-H004 are preserved exactly as historical V1 research (no relabel, no re-evaluation)

review_decisions.Q1: approved with modification: research feed matches intended live feed by default; mismatch preregistered + justified + authoritative feed + mandatory P5; SIP primary only if it is the intended operational feed
review_decisions.Q2: approved with modification: direction-normalized success and favorable move; B = primary fails the same P2 percentile rule vs the same frozen random controls recomputed at canonical cost; signed <= 0 descriptive only
review_decisions.Q3: approved: isolated execution precheck mandatory to report, non-gating
review_decisions.Q4: approved; clarified 2026-09-25: stage-based status (P1-P3 failures only -> REJECTED_AT_RAW_SIGNAL_SCREEN; P4 only -> REJECTED_AT_ECONOMIC_SCALE; P5 only -> REJECTED_AT_FEED_ROBUSTNESS; more than one distinct stage or any P6 failure -> REJECTED_PRE_PORTFOLIO); umbrella field and per-gate outcomes always recorded
review_decisions.Q5: no global scheduled-entry baseline; optional and fully preregistered per hypothesis
review_decisions.Q6: approved: no Validation-period feed access before spec freeze, P1-P6 PASS, D1-D6 PASS, frozen implementation and recorded commit
review_decisions.Q7: approved: tag H005 with research_protocol_v2 and extend registry statuses when H005 is created; H001-H004 untouched
clarifications: P2 percentile/tie convention frozen as implemented and tested
P5 NOT_APPLICABLE only when genuinely not applicable under V2
any unmeasured mandatory gate is FAIL
